name: SandBase Harness MCP Bridge
description: A stdio MCP bridge for the self-hosted SandBase Harness AI agent runtime, exposing agent discovery, persistent session execution, artifacts, and session control.
author: sandbaseai

MANAGED_AGENTS_URL.description: Base URL of the connected SandBase Harness API; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000 when omitted.

MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for an authenticated SandBase Harness API.
